subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Psychological Safety at Work
description: Learn Psychological Safety at Work in one minute.

hook.text: An employee spots a compliance risk but stays quiet. Why? She saw what happened to the last person who spoke up.

buildup.text: Psychological safety means employees can raise concerns without fear of punishment, embarrassment, or retaliation.

discovery.text: Google's Project Aristotle found that psychological safety was the single most important factor in team effectiveness.

twist.text: Compliance programs depend on people speaking up. Without psychological safety, reporting channels are useless.

climax.text: Building psychological safety requires leaders to model vulnerability, reward reporting, and respond constructively.

punchline.text: Speak up safely. Or stay silent. Culture decides which.

quiz.question: What did Google's Project Aristotle find?
options: Psychological safety is the most important factor in team effectiveness
